claim: Opens a saved chat, call, email, or phone link for a teammate
where: landing preview, app detail panel, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /app.html with the shipped sample loaded; intercept the platform opener and assert exact saved Slack, Teams, Meet/HTTPS, email, Zoom, and phone URLs open

claim: Roster, status, and imported calendar data stay on this device unless the user explicitly downloads a presence update; clearing site storage removes them
where: landing hero, privacy page, app settings, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; change status and import a calendar while asserting every request is same-origin and the real namespace stays untouched; then create and clear a real roster

claim: Presence changes only when the user chooses a status or imports a calendar; keyboard and pointer activity are not monitored and no analytics request is sent
where: landing privacy section, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; choose away, simulate keyboard and pointer activity, then assert the status remains away and no external request occurs

claim: Presence Bridge does not transport messages; it only opens the saved contact tool
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; use Ava's Slack contact tool, assert the explicit open result, and assert no external request occurs

claim: Imports .ics calendar events locally to set busy status
where: landing privacy section, app settings, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; upload an in-memory active ICS event and assert it is imported

claim: Works after the first visit, even offline
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; wait for service worker, reload once, set the context offline, reload, and assert sample data

claim: The free local roster holds five people
where: landing hero, pricing section, app limit notice, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; add a fifth person and assert that adding a sixth shows the free limit

claim: Demo changes never touch the real roster
sandbox: fresh browser context; change demo status, open app.html, and assert the real roster remains empty

claim: Resetting, leaving, or closing the demo discards its changes
sandbox: fresh isolated browser contexts at /?demo=1; change status, exercise Reset and Start for real, close the context, reopen the demo, and assert the seed is restored after every path

claim: One click shows four sample teammates and the user's status, with named teammate rows in the first 390 by 844 viewport
where: landing first screen, demo route metadata, README
sandbox: fresh 390 by 844 browser context at /; click Try it with sample data once, assert four rows and realistic names, and measure the first two row bottoms inside the viewport

claim: Bridge Plus supports ten people and two contact tools per person
where: landing pricing section, app settings, terms, README
sandbox: fresh browser context with the license verify endpoint fulfilled by a valid fixture; assert the second contact tool field and ten-person limit

claim: This release does not show a Bridge Plus purchase link while Sociobot checkout is unavailable
where: landing pricing section, app settings, terms, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; intercept the documented checkout API with its recorded 404 and assert landing and app Settings show no purchase link and never request that endpoint

claim: License verification sends only the license token to the Sociobot billing API
sandbox: fresh browser context starting at /demo; enter a fixture license in the real app, intercept verification, and assert its URL, method, and empty request body

claim: Downloads the local roster as a readable JSON backup
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; download the sample roster and parse the saved JSON to assert its people

claim: A teammate can import an explicitly shared chosen presence update into their local roster
where: app settings, landing privacy section, privacy page, terms, README
sandbox: two isolated browser contexts at /app.html; one downloads a chosen status update and the other imports it, asserting the status appears with no calendar, contact-tool, or message data

claim: The installed desktop app can watch a user-chosen shared folder, import newer presence files, mark day-old updates stale, and stop watching
sandbox: fresh browser context with the native folder commands fulfilled by recorded local-file fixtures; choose a folder, assert initial and changed statuses, assert stale marking, stop watching, and assert the local grant is removed

claim: A v* tag runs GitHub Actions builds for macOS, Windows, and Linux, including AppImage and Debian package targets
sandbox: clean repository; inspect the tag trigger, three-runner matrix, Tauri all-target bundle configuration, and Linux manifest package filters

claim: macOS and Windows release builds remain unsigned unless the owner configures signing certificates
sandbox: clean repository; inspect the release workflow and assert Apple and Windows signing variables are set only inside non-empty owner-secret guards

claim: No payment provider runs inside this release of the app
sandbox: fresh browser context at /app.html; record requests while opening Settings and inspect the production dependency/import surface for embedded payment-provider code

claim: The download page chooses a package for the detected platform from GitHub release information
sandbox: fresh Chromium browser context on /download with a recorded GitHub release fixture; assert the detected Linux AppImage link is rendered

claim: Each published desktop release includes SHA256SUMS and latest.json
sandbox: fresh Chromium browser context on /download with a recorded GitHub release fixture; assert checksum and manifest links are rendered

claim: The download page gives a release-page link when release information is unavailable
sandbox: fresh Chromium browser context on /download with the GitHub metadata request returning 503; assert the calm fallback and release-page link

claim: The Linux installer verifies SHA256SUMS before it installs the AppImage
sandbox: isolated temporary PATH with a recorded release response and AppImage fixture; run install.sh and execute the installed checksum-verified fixture

claim: The Windows release job verifies the setup checksum before it launches the installer
sandbox: read the shipped PowerShell installer and Windows release job; assert Get-FileHash and the checksum failure branch occur before Start-Process, then assert the Windows smoke job invokes the installer
